summary: Asvalo’s first-property setup should center on separate admin/accounting/property teams, corporate group leases, separate corporate-versus-occupant balances, subsidy ledgers for the existing assisted residents, automated late fees and notices, custom applications and move-in documents, weekly corporate-housing inspections, and ACH-first payments. The later scoping call changed the preferred third-party-owner model from treating owners as vendors to standard property management. Major open items are the lender-approved lease structure, cross-property corporate billing workaround, screening thresholds, late-fee amount, insurance rules, utility metering, and the final property/entity hierarchy. Calls c1-c3 were outreach/voicemail calls and contained no configuration decisions.

Asvalo Real Estate/Entrata disovery call
callsUsed.brief: Ron, Jon, Vincent and Madison from Entrata, along with Jezarella, Sean and Josh from Asvalo Real Estate, discussed Asvalo's unique corporate housing model, which involves master leases, subletting, and a significant pipeline of 800 modular units in Texas. The conversation focused on how Entrata's software could accommodate this complex structure, particularly regarding financial reporting for separate entities, managing corporate group leases, and handling bulk unit allocations and payments. Entrata committed to an internal review and follow-up demos to determine the best solution for Asvalo's rapid growth and specific operational needs.

callsUsed.title: Onsite demo with Asvalo/Entrata
callsUsed.brief: Rolanda and Jon from Entrata, along with Jezarella, Josh and Sean from Asvalo Real Estate, discussed Entrata's property management platform, focusing on its applicability to Asvalo's corporate housing model, including screening, payment processing, and owner reporting. Key areas of discussion included customizing screening for corporate clients, automating financial processes, and the system's flexibility in managing group leases and property visibility for different team members. Asvalo expressed interest in Entrata's AI capabilities and its potential to streamline operations and reporting for their growing portfolio.

callsUsed.title: Entrata Scoping call with Asvalo
callsUsed.brief: Madison and David from Entrata, along with Jezarella and Josh from Asvalo Real Estate, discussed the implementation of Entrata's property management software, covering product scope, pricing, and a detailed timeline for onboarding Asvalo's diverse portfolio of existing and new prefab properties. Key topics included insurance, screening, corporate billing complexities, and the integration of various property types, with Asvalo aiming for a decision by the end of the month, pending final pricing and internal alignment.

callsUsed.title: Pricing call with Asvalo/Entrata
callsUsed.brief: Madison from Entrata, along with Josh from Asvalo Real Estate, discussed Entrata's pricing proposal, including core features, AI platforms, renter's insurance, and utility management, with Josh expressing satisfaction with the logical layout and potential for future use. They also addressed questions regarding credit card payments for vendors and insurance verification frequency, with a follow-up meeting scheduled for next week to review the proposal further.

callsUsed.title: Entrata/Insurance demo with Asvalo
callsUsed.brief: Madison and Cassie from Entrata, along with Jezarella from Asvalo Real Estate, discussed Entrata's insurance programs, including renter's insurance, a master policy, and insurance verification, as well as their deposit alternative program. Jezarella expressed interest in using Entrata's insurance for their new corporate housing units due to its simplicity and confirmed that the deposit alternative, while different from her previous experience, could be beneficial for future residential properties. Madison will follow up with a recording, program details, and flyers for Jezarella to review.
